Create the App: In the OptiSigns portal, go to Files/Assets > Apps and select the YouTube app.

To pair a new screen with your OptiSigns account, follow these steps:

Install the App: Download and install the OptiSigns app on your player device from optisigns.com/download.

Create the Asset: In the OptiSigns portal, go to Assets > Add Asset > Apps and select Website.

Assign to Screen: Go to the Screens tab, click the screen you want to use, select Asset as the content type, and then select the website asset you just created.
Save: Click Save to begin displaying the website on your screen.

Logins & Security: If a website requires a login or has specific security requirements, the standard Website app may not work. In these cases, consider using a Dedicated App (if available for that service), Web Scripting, or Secured Dashboard.

How to Create and Use the Split Screen App

result.text:
OptiBot

To use the Split Screen feature in OptiSigns, follow these steps:

Create the App: Navigate to the Files/Assets tab, click App, and select Split Screen.
Select/Customize Layout: Choose a template or create a custom layout by adjusting zone dimensions, adding/deleting zones, and configuring the orientation.
Assign Content: Click each zone to assign the specific content (asset, playlist, or schedule) you want to display.
Save: Preview your layout, then click Save to add it to your Asset list.
Deploy: Go to the Screens tab, click Edit on your desired screen, and set the Type to Asset, then select your new Split Screen asset.

For more details on configuration settings like resolution, audio zones, or troubleshooting display ratios, refer to the full guide here: Article URL: https://support.optisigns.com/hc/en-us/articles/360026559573-How-to-Create-and-Use-the-Split-Screen-App.
